entities.name: Bisesero Genocide Memorial
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Bisesero Genocide Memorial is a national memorial in Rwanda which commemorates the 1994 Genocide against the Tutsi in Rwanda. 40,000 people were killed where the memorial now stands.
